estimates: Approximate silhouette, divided roof forms and cladding, based on the mapped outer perimeter and public written descriptions.
The model covers the visible dome and connected major masses, with simplified window bands and a graded foundation.
Photographs, other premises and detailed site features were excluded.

review.notes: Checked published Qualla media first. No image was adopted. The standing public silhouette uses the Dutch building-register outline and the operator’s written identification of the concrete dome.
